description: An unsigned transaction to make the wallet's receiving address (once; anyone may make it, and it always works for the owner and no one else). Payments sent to the address before it is made wait there and are swept once it is. Refuses owners whose address could never be spent from (the zero address, Borro's own contracts, another receiving address). Simulated from the wallet; nothing is sent.
